THE CHALLENGE

Why this is hard today.

Deployed is not the same as effective

A control can be in place and still fail the checks it is expected to pass.

Coverage gaps hide

An asset without a healthy agent weakens the controls that depend on it.

Pass rates lack detail

A percentage is only useful with a path to the checks behind it.

HOW SAFORA HELPS

Three steps, one workspace.

  1. 01

    Review the assessment

    Security Control Validation shows the controls assessed, passed and failed checks, and the pass rate.

  2. 02

    Open a failed check

    Each finding carries its evidence, the affected control and investigation guidance.

  3. 03

    Check the coverage

    Agent Coverage & Health shows where coverage conditions need review.
